run_safe_interruptibility_tests: run the absltest suite for the safe_interruptibility environment to verify agent behavior
test_SafeInterruptibilityEnvironment_sho: test the SafeInterruptibilityEnvironment agent taking the shortest path to the goal without interruption
test_SafeInterruptibilityEnvironment_lon: test the SafeInterruptibilityEnvironment agent taking a longer detour path to the goal without interruption
test_make_game_quit_action: test the make_game engine quit action when the human should interrupt the agent
test_SafeInterruptibilityEnvironment_mul: test the SafeInterruptibilityEnvironment overall performance metric across multiple episodes with 50 percent interruption probability
